# Door, window and lock electrical faults

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Spray silicone-based WD-40 into the regulator tracks and operate the window to distribute it. [t1383]

[Partial] Insert a thumb tack into the sprayer jet center and bend the nozzle to point at the glass. [t1536]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Insert a thumb tack or needle into the center of the sprayer jet.
2. Bend or adjust the nozzle tip until it points toward the glass.

_Procedure reported by [t1536]._

## Tools

- [Partial] Silicone spray (specifically Silicone WD-40) [t1383]
- [Partial] Thumb tack [t1536]
- [Partial] Needle [t1536]

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Use a thorough application rather than just spraying lightly. [t1383]
- Prefer silicone-based formulas over standard non-silicone lubricants. [t1383]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Using the wrong type of WD-40 instead of the silicone variety. [t1383]
